questions.q: Who was the just Christian king of Abyssinia?
questions.explain: An-Najashi was the title of the king of Abyssinia, whose real name was Ashamah.

options: An African land across the Red Sea, now Ethiopia and Eritrea
questions.explain: Abyssinia lay across the Red Sea, the place of the first migration.

questions.q: How many companions migrated in the first group to Abyssinia?
questions.explain: Sixteen companions crossed the Red Sea from Jeddah at night.

questions.q: Who was the husband of Ruqayyah bint Muhammad who migrated with her?
questions.explain: Uthman and Ruqayyah migrated to Abyssinia together.

questions.q: Who did Quraysh send with costly gifts to ask Najashi to return the Muslims?
questions.explain: Amr bin Al-As was a debater, but he failed.

questions.q: Who was chosen as the Muslims' spokesman before the king?
questions.explain: Ja'far, the Prophet's cousin, spoke before Najashi.

questions.q: Which surah did Ja'far recite that made Najashi weep?
questions.explain: Ja'far chose Surah Maryam because Najashi was a Christian who honoured Maryam.

questions.q: What did Najashi do with the gifts from Amr?
questions.explain: A bribe does not change justice. Najashi returned all the gifts.

questions.q: The companions prostrated to King Najashi out of respect.
questions.explain: False. Prostration is for Allah alone.

questions.q: Najashi listened to both sides before deciding.
questions.explain: True. A just king does not side with one party only.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Najashi refuses to hand over the Muslims

questions.explain: The companions migrated, Amr brought gifts, Ja'far was chosen, recited Maryam, and Najashi refused to hand them over.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A person skilled at convincing others in debate
One who met the Prophet SAW, believed and died in Islam
The sea between Hijaz and Africa

questions.explain: Hijaz is the region of Makkah, the Red Sea lies between Hijaz and Africa, a companion met and believed in the Prophet SAW, and a debater is good at persuading.
